title: Prosthetics II: Main Exam, 17 December 2018
programme: Bachelor of Science in Dental Technology
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A (COMPULSORY) AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS IN SECTION B

items.text: What are the factors that determine the shade selection in artificial teeth.
Give the importance of working up of a denture.
State two contra indications of relining.
Explain what resilient on soft timing materials of a denture are.
Define rebasing as applied in prosthetics.
Write down four indications of rebasing.
State two errors that could arise by setting lower anserior teeth more lingual in a class II Jew relationship.
What is the importance of denture identification?
Give four requirements of a denture identification.
Discuss aesthetical considerations in teeth selection during complete denture fabrication.

parts.text: Describe the laboratory procedure of rebasing using flasking method.
What are the problems, causes and the solutions associated with the flasking method of rebasing.
What are soft linens? Write down the uses of tissue conditioners.
Explain the composition of tissue conditioners and the properties that make them effective.
